# NSPanel HAUI 0.5.7

0.5.7 changes nothing a panel runs. It makes installing and updating the integration about five times smaller.

GitHub builds the source archive — the zip a HACS or Marketplace install downloads — from the repository, and `nextion/` carried ~59 MB of display sources and compiled TFTs that no install reads. That directory is now marked `export-ignore`, so an install or update downloads about 16 MB instead of about 74 MB.

This release updates the integration only. Both TFTs are unchanged, so display version 0.4.5 remains required.

## Before updating

Nothing. No TFT update, no renamed entity, no changed service, no migration. Panels already running 0.5.6 update firmware through the hub as usual.
